forest.statement:
Optimize on one NVIDIA GH200 with CUDA 12.6.3. Use the actual AB-MCTS research trees and persistent Mother memory/integration policy.
Reduce n signed int32 integers to one exact int32 sum. Values are bounded to [-5,5], so the true sum fits int32. Performance n=4194304 (2^22); checks include n=1,127,1024,65536 and performance n. input1=x; input2,input3 ignored. output has one int32; scratch contains 2*n+65536 int32 values. Complete the entire reduction on device, not only the first stage.
Edit only src/candidate.cu. Preserve extern C void run(const void*x,const void*k,const void*gy,void*out,void*scratch,int n,int h,int l,int ks). All pointers are device memory owned by the host. Use the default CUDA stream. Do not read beyond buffers. Scratch is not guaranteed initialized. No external optimized library calls; ordinary CUDA primitives and CUB block primitives are allowed.
No cached answers, filesystem or environment inspection, timing inspection, phase detection, or external tools. Every call must compute on the current input. Immutable reference implementations and correctness checks are withheld from source. Choose useful topics independently, record failures, complete memory integration and independently confirm final G. No additional allocations or devices.

Lire l’implémentation T2 de réduction en limbs avant de décider si elle constitue une alternative compatible à CUB dans le candidat Gm2.

Partir de Gm2, le meilleur candidat mesuré valide (7,50 µs), et tester la réduction intra-bloc par limbs 16 bits de 5da48cd7af1d48fe (valide, 30,15 µs) dans sa hiérarchie à tuiles de 4096. Conserver la topologie et les chemins de Gm2; la performance plus lente de 5da seule ne permet pas de conclure sur cette combinaison. Faire mesurer et vérifier l’intégration sans présumer d’un gain, en gardant Gm2 comme référence.

experiments.hypothesis: Keeping the baseline 128-thread shared-memory reduction tree while storing every partial in int64 should preserve exact cancellation behavior.
